name: moody-retro-varsity-editorial
image_purpose: Fashion editorial, carousel cover, and moodboard

prompt.project_info: Create a cinematic full-body editorial photograph of three approved adult women in a vintage-inspired school corridor.
prompt.main_subject: Three approved adult women with blonde, auburn, and brunette hair, each wearing a navy varsity letterman jacket with cream leather sleeves and a prominent golden H patch, paired with solid-colored opaque athletic bottoms in dark teal and deep burgundy and pointed-toe pumps. They stand with poised serious expressions and look back toward the camera.
prompt.composition_elements: Full-body three-person composition at the top of a tiled staircase, with forest-green metal lockers, industrial concrete walls, stair rails, and a dim vintage high-school corridor. Keep the three hair colors and jacket hierarchy distinct; treat the H as a generic garment patch, not a new brand logo.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Sharp directional corridor light with controlled shadow, highlighting jacket wool, cream sleeves, shoe leather, tiled steps, and concrete texture. Moody nostalgic 1980s atmosphere with restrained color.
prompt.technical_specs: 35mm editorial lens look, full-body vertical frame, deep enough focus for all three subjects, natural skin texture, subtle film grain, lifted blacks, high-contrast but realistic color treatment.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A cinematic full-body editorial photograph of three approved adult women with distinct blonde, auburn, and brunette hair standing at the top of a tiled school staircase and looking back over their shoulders with poised serious expressions. They wear matching navy blue varsity letterman jackets with cream-colored leather sleeves and generic golden H patches, paired with solid-colored opaque athletic bottoms in dark teal and deep burgundy and elegant pointed-toe pumps in beige and chocolate brown. The setting is a dim vintage-inspired school corridor with forest-green metal lockers, industrial concrete walls, tiled steps, and directional overhead light. Emphasize realistic wool, leather, tile, and concrete texture, a moody nostalgic 1980s aesthetic, 35mm editorial framing, and subtle film grain.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, exposed intimate areas, child or teen appearance, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, harsh flash, extra limbs, deformed hands, invented logos, random text, watermark, low resolution, blur
